A 8 Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 - s. 110-A - Motor accident - Permanent disability - Claim for compensation - Tribunal C awarded compensation of Rs.3,20,0001- - High Court enhanced the compensation to Rs. 7, 04, 8001- after taking loss of earning capacity to 70% in view of permanent disability - On rightly assessed loss of earning capacity to 70% as per Workmen's Compensation Act D - Since the courts below did not allow reasonable amount for different pecuniary and non-pecuniary damages, the amount of compensation re-determined to Rs.11,64,3001- - Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923.
